source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent vintage desk globe progressing from pale graphite construction to a finished graphite and restrained dusty-teal, ochre, and brass colored-pencil sketch.
source.notes: Keep the same three-quarter globe, tilted diagonal axis, meridian support, two pivot knobs, short pedestal, round base, simplified continent shapes, curved coordinate lines, and cast shadow in every applicable frame. No text, country labels, border labels, extra desk props, or final-only motifs.

process_strategy: Construct the globe as one tilted sphere held inside a meridian arc and fixed to a short pedestal before adding map shapes, coordinate curves, small hardware, shading, or color, so every later mark attaches to the same visible perspective.

final_elements.name: tilted sphere, axis, support arc, pedestal, and base guides
final_elements.description: One pale globe circle with a diagonal polar axis, one outer meridian arc, two pivot reserves, one short centered pedestal, one round base footprint, and one broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: complete vintage desk globe silhouette
final_elements.description: The globe edge, full meridian support, top and lower pivot knobs, short pedestal stem, stepped collar, and low round base wrapped around the fixed guides.

final_elements.name: simplified continent silhouettes and coordinate curves
final_elements.description: A small group of simplified landmass silhouettes without text or borders, plus a few curved latitude and longitude lines following the established sphere.

final_elements.name: brass hardware, globe seams, base rings, and shadow
final_elements.description: Small pivot caps, meridian edge bands, pedestal seams, concentric base rings, restrained map-edge hatching, and one broken graphite cast shadow.

final_elements.name: graphite modeling and restrained vintage color
final_elements.description: Soft graphite planes, dusty-teal pencil on the established ocean areas, warm ochre on the land shapes, muted brass on the support and base, charcoal accents, and preserved paper highlights.

rejection_checks: The same sphere size, diagonal axis, globe tilt, meridian support, two pivot positions, pedestal, base, crop, and scale must persist through all six panels.
All land shapes, coordinate curves, hardware, base rings, color areas, paper highlights, and the cast shadow must appear before the final panel and persist through the finish.
No text, numbers, country labels, border labels, logo, compass rose, desk scene, books, pen, plant, decorative background, or final-only motif may appear.
No adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size, and the finish must remain a believable 20-25 minute handmade sketch rather than polished scientific illustration.
